44.ar: الصّادق (- عَنْ دَاوُدَ الرَّقِّیِّ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عزّوجلّ وَ إِنْ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَ لکِنْ لا تَفْقَهُونَ.
44.fa: داود رقّی گوید: امام صادق (علیه السلام) فرمود: درباره‌ی آیه: وَ إِن مِّن شَیْءٍ إِلاَّ یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدَهِ وَلَکِن لاَّ تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِیحَهُمْ، پرسیدم. ایشان فرمود: «صدایی که در اثر شکاف و سستی دیوارها از آن‌ها شنیده می‌شود، تسبیح آن‌ها است».
44.en: Dawud al-Raqqi said: I asked Abu Abd Allah (Imam al-Sadiq) about the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "And there is not a thing but glorifies Him with His praise, but you do not understand their glorification." He said: "The sound that is heard from walls due to their cracking and weakening is their glorification."
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 184
44.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 6, p. 531; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 57, p. 177; Al-Mahasin, Vol. 2, p. 623; Nur al-Thaqalayn

44.ar: الباقر (- عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَال سَأَلْتُ أَبَاجَعْفَرٍ (عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ وَ إِنْ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ قَالَ إِنَّا نَرَی أَنَّ تَنَقُّضَ الْحِیطَانِ تَسْبِیحُهَا.
44.fa: زراره گوید: از امام باقر (علیه السلام) در مورد آیه: وَ إِنْ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ، پرسیدم. فرمود: «همه‌چیز به حمد او تسبیح گوید و به نظر ما شکست دیوار [در حقیقت] تسبیح آن است».
44.en: Zurarah said: I asked Abu Ja'far (al-Baqir) about the saying of Allah, "And there is not a thing but that it exalts [Allah] by His praise." He said: "Everything exalts Him by His praise, and in our view, the cracking of walls is its exaltation."
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 184
44.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 57, p. 177 / al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 294 / Nur al-Thaqalayn

44.ar: الباقر (- عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ (عَنْ أَبِیهِ (أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَیْهِ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ ... أَ تُسَبِّحُ الشَّجَرَةُ الْیَابِسَةُ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ أَ مَا سَمِعْتَ خَشَبَ الْبَیْتِ تَنَقَّضَ وَ ذَلِکَ تَسْبِیحُهُ فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَلَی کُلِّ حَالٍ.
44.fa: مسعده‌بن‌صدقه گوید: امام باقر (علیه السلام) از پدرش روایت فرمود: شخصی خدمت ایشان رسید و عرض کرد: «... یعنی درخت خشک، خدا را تسبیح می‌گوید»؟ امام (علیه السلام) فرمود: «آری! آیا نشنیده‌ای چوب‌های سقف خانه چگونه صدای شکستن و خش‌خش دارند؟ این همان تسبیح آنهاست، در هرحال خداوند، پاک و منزّه است».
44.en: Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah narrates that a man came to Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) and asked him, "... Does a dry tree glorify God?" The Imam replied, "Yes. Have you not heard the creaking and cracking sounds of the wooden beams of a house? That is their glorification. So, glory be to God in every state."
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 184
44.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 57, p. 177; al-'Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 294; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

44.ar: علی بن إبراهیم (- فِی قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَی وَإِنْ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ فَحَرَکَةُ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ تَسْبِیحٌ لِلَّهِ عزّوجلّ.
44.fa: وَ إِنْ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ؛ جنبش هرچیزی تسبیح او برای خدای عزّوجلّ است.
44.en: Regarding the saying of the Exalted, "And there is not a thing but that it exalts [Allah] by His praise," the movement of everything is a glorification (tasbih) for Allah, the Almighty and Majestic.
44.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 57, p. 179; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 20

44.ar: الحسین (- أَنَّ الْحُسَیْنَ (سُئِلَ فِی حَالِ صِغَرِهِ عَنْ أَصْوَاتِ الْحَیَوَانَاتِ لِأَنَّ مِنْ شَرْطِ الْإِمَامِ أَنْ یَکُونَ عَالِماً بِجَمِیعِ اللُّغَاتِ حَتَّی أَصْوَاتِ الْحَیَوَانَاتِ فَقَالَ عَلَی مَا رَوَی مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِیمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِیمِیُّ عَنِ الْحُسَیْنِ (أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِذَا صَاحَ النَّسْرُ فَإِنَّهُ یَقُولُ یَا ابْنَ آدَمَ (عِشْ مَا شِئْتَ فَآخِرُهُ الْمَوْتُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْبَازِی یَقُولُ یَا عَالِمَ الْخَفِیَّاتِ وَ یَا کَاشِفَ الْبَلِیَّاتِ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الطَّاوُسُ یَقُولُ مَوْلَایَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِی وَ اغْتَرَرْتُ بِزِینَتِی فَاغْفِرْ لِی وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الدُّرَّاجُ یَقُولُ الرَّحْمَنُ عَلَی الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَی وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الدِّیکُ یَقُولُ مَنْ عَرَفَ اللَّهَ لَمْ یَنْسَ ذِکْرَهُ وَ إِذَا قَرْقَرَتِ الدَّجَاجَةُ تَقُولُ یَا إِلَهَ الْحَقِّ أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ وَ قَوْلُکَ الْحَقُّ یَا اللَّهُ یَا حَقُّ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْبَاشَقُ یَقُولُ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَ الْیَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَ إِذَا صَاحَتِ الحداء {الْحِدَأَةُ} تَقُولُ تَوَکَّلْ عَلَی اللَّهِ تُرْزَقْ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْعُقَابُ یَقُولُ مَنْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ لَمْ یَشْقَ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الشَّاهِینُ یَقُولُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حَقّاً حَقّاً وَ إِذَا صَاحَتِ الْبُومَةُ یَقُولُ الْبُعْدُ مِنَ النَّاسِ أُنْسٌ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْغُرَابُ یَقُولُ یَا رَازِقُ ابْعَثِ الرِّزْقَ الْحَلَالَ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْکُرْکِیُّ یَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِی مِنْ عَدُوِّی وَ إِذَا صَاحَ اللَّقْلَقُ یَقُولُ مَنْ تَخَلَّی عَنِ النَّاسِ نَجَا مِنْ أَذَاهُمْ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْبَطَّةُ تَقُولُ غُفْرَانَکَ یَا اللَّهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْهُدْهُدُ یَقُولُ مَا أَشْقَی مَ-نْ عَصَی اللَّهَ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْقُمْرِیُّ یَقُولُ یَا عَالِمَ السِّرِّ وَ النَّجْوَی یَا اللَّهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الدُّبْسِیُّ یَقُولُ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ سِوَاکَ یَا اللَّهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْعَقْعَقُ یَقُولُ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا یَخْفَی عَلَیْهِ خَافِیَةٌ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْبَبَّغَاءُ یَقُولُ مَنْ ذَکَرَ رَبَّهُ غَفَرَ ذَنْبَهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْعُصْفُورُ یَقُولُ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ مِمَّا یُسْخِطُ اللَّهَ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْبُلْبُلُ یَقُولُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ حَقّاً حَقّاً وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْقَبْجَةُ تَقُولُ قَرُبَ الْحَقُّ قَرُبَ وَ إِذَا صَاحَتِ السُّمَانَاةُ یَقُولُ یَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مَا أَغْفَلَکَ عَنِ الْمَوْتِ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ السَّوْذَنِیقُ یَقُولُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَ آلُهُ خِیَرَةُ اللَّهِ وَ إِذَا صَاحَتِ الْفَاخِتَةُ یَا وَاحِدُ یَا أَحَدُ یَا فَرْدُ یَا صَمَدُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الشِّقِرَّاقُ یَقُولُ مَوْلَایَ أَعْتِقْنِی مِنَ النَّارِ وَ إِذَا صَاحَتِ الْقُنْبُرَةُ تَقُولُ مَوْلَایَ تُبْ عَلَی کُلِّ مُذْنِبٍ مِنَ الْمُذْنِبِینَ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْوَرَشَانُ یَقُولُ إِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ ذَنْبِی شَقِیتُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الشِّفْنِینُ یَقُولُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِیِّ الْعَظِیمِ وَ إِذَا صَاحَتِ النَّعَامَةُ تَقُولُ لَا مَعْبُودَ سِوَی اللَّهِ وَ إِذَا صَاحَتِ الْخُطَّافَةُ فَإِنَّهَا تَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْحَمْدِ وَ تَقُولُ یَا قَابِلَ تَوْبَةِ التَّوَّابِینَ یَا اللَّهُ لَکَ الْحَمْدُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَتِ الزَّرَافَةُ تَقُولُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْحَمَلُ یَقُولُ کَفَی بِالْمَوْتِ وَاعِظاً وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْجَدْیُ یَقُولُ عَاجَلَنِیَ الْمَوْتُ ثَقُلَ ذَنْبِی وَ ازْدَادَ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْأَسَدُ یَقُولُ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مُهِمٌّ مُهِمٌّ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الثَّوْرُ یَقُولُ مَهْلًا مَهْلًا یَا ابْنَ آدَمَ أَنْتَ بَیْنَ یَدَیْ مَنْ یَرَی وَ لَا یُرَی وَ هُوَ اللَّهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْفِیلُ یَقُولُ لَا یُغْنِی عَنِ الْمَوْتِ قُوَّةٌ وَ لَا حِیلَةٌ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْفَهْدُ یَقُولُ یَا عَزِیزُ یَا جَبَّارُ یَا مُتَکَبِّرُ یَا اللَّهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْجَمَلُ یَقُولُ سُبْحَانَ مُذِلِّ الْجَبَّارِینَ سُبْحَانَهُ وَ إِذَا صَهَلَ الْفَرَسُ یَقُولُ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا سُبْحَانَهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الذِّئْبُ یَقُولُ مَا حَفِظَ اللَّهُ لَنْ یَضِیعَ أَبَداً وَ إِذَا صَاحَ ابْنُ آوَی یَقُولُ الْوَیْلُ الْوَیْلُ لِلْمُذْنِبِ الْمُصِرِّ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْکَلْبُ یَقُولُ کَفَی بِالْمَعَاصِی ذُلًّا وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْأَرْنَبُ یَقُولُ لَا تُهْلِکْنِی یَا اللَّهُ لَکَ الْحَمْدُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الثَّعْلَبُ یَقُولُ الدُّنْیَا دَارُ غُرُورٍ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْغَزَالُ یَقُولُ نَجِّنِی مِنَ الْأَذَی وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْکَرْکَدَّنُ یَقُولُ أَغِثْنِی وَ إِلَّا هَلَکْتُ یَا مَوْلَایَ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ الْإِبِلُ یَقُولُ حَسْبِیَ اللهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَکِیلُ حَسْبِیَ اللَّهُ وَ إِذَا صَاحَ النَّمِرُ یَقُولُ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تَعَزَّزَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَ إِذَا سَبَّحَتِ الْحَیَّةُ تَقُولُ مَا أَشْقَی مَنْ عَصَاکَ یَا رَحْمَانُ وَ إِذَا سَبَّحَتِ الْعَقْرَبُ تَقُولُ الشَّرُّ شَیْءٌ وَحْشٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ (مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا وَ لَهُ تَسْبِیحٌ یَحْمَدُ بِهِ رَبَّهُ ثُمَّ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآیَةَ وَ إِنْ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَ لکِنْ لا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِیحَهُمْ.
44.en:
When al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was a child, he was asked about the sounds of animals, because it is a condition of the Imam that he be knowledgeable of all languages, even the sounds of animals. According to the narration of Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn al-Harith al-Tamimi, al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said:

When the vulture cries, it says: "O son of Adam, live as you wish, for the end of it is death."
When the hawk cries, it says: "O Knower of the hidden, O Reliever of calamities."
When the peacock cries, it says: "My Master, I have wronged myself and been deceived by my adornment, so forgive me."
When the francolin cries, it says: "The Most Gracious has established Himself upon the Throne."
When the rooster crows, it says: "Whoever knows God does not forget His remembrance."
When the hen clucks, it says: "O God of Truth, You are the Truth, and Your word is the Truth, O God, O Truth."
When the sparrowhawk cries, it says: "I have believed in God and the Last Day."
When the kite cries, it says: "Trust in God, and you shall be provided for."
When the eagle cries, it says: "Whoever obeys God shall not be wretched."
When the falcon cries, it says: "Glory be to God, truly, truly."
When the owl cries, it says: "Distance from people is comfort."
When the crow cries, it says: "O Provider, send down lawful provision."
When the crane cries, it says: "O God, protect me from my enemy."
When the stork cries, it says: "Whoever withdraws from people is saved from their harm."
When the duck cries, it says: "Your forgiveness, O God."
When the hoopoe cries, it says: "How wretched is he who disobeys God."
When the turtledove cries, it says: "O Knower of the secret and the whispered, O God."
When the palm dove cries, it says: "You are God, there is no god but You, O God."
When the magpie cries, it says: "Glory be to Him from whom no hidden thing is concealed."
When the parrot cries, it says: "Whoever remembers his Lord, his sin is forgiven."
When the sparrow cries, it says: "I seek forgiveness from God for that which angers God."
When the nightingale cries, it says: "There is no god but God, truly, truly."
When the partridge cries, it says: "The Truth has drawn near, drawn near."
When the quail cries, it says: "O son of Adam, how heedless are you of death!"
When the [bird] cries, it says: "There is no god but God; Muhammad and his family are the chosen of God."
When the dove cries, it says: "O One, O Unique, O Individual, O Eternal."
When the roller bird cries, it says: "My Master, free me from the Fire."
When the lark cries, it says: "My Master, repent toward every sinner among the sinners."
When the wood pigeon cries, it says: "If You do not forgive my sin, I am wretched."
When the [bird] cries, it says: "There is no power except by God, the High, the Great."
When the ostrich cries, it says: "There is no worshipped one except God."
When the swallow cries, it recites Surah al-Hamd and says: "O Acceptor of the repentance of the repentant, O God, to You is the praise."
When the giraffe cries, it says: "There is no god but God, He is One."
When the lamb cries, it says: "Death is a sufficient admonisher."
When the kid cries, it says: "Death has hastened to me; my sin has become heavy and increased."
When the lion roars, it says: "The command of God is important, important."
When the bull bellows, it says: "Slowly, slowly, O son of Adam; you are before Him who sees and is not seen, and He is God."
When the elephant cries, it says: "Neither strength nor trickery avails against death."
When the leopard cries, it says: "O Almighty, O Compeller, O Majestic, O God."
When the camel cries, it says: "Glory be to the Humbler of the tyrants, glory be to Him."
When the horse neighs, it says: "Glory be to our Lord, glory be to Him."
When the wolf howls, it says: "Whatever God protects shall never be lost."
When the jackal cries, it says: "Woe, woe to the persistent sinner."
When the dog barks, it says: "Sins are sufficient for humiliation."
When the rabbit cries, it says: "Do not destroy me, O God, to You is the praise."
When the fox cries, it says: "The world is a house of deception."
When the gazelle cries, it says: "Save me from harm."
When the rhinoceros cries, it says: "Help me, or I shall perish, O my Master."
When the camel cries, it says: "God is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs; God is sufficient for me."
When the tiger cries, it says: "Glory be to Him who is mighty through His power, glory be to Him."
When the snake glorifies, it says: "How wretched is he who disobeys You, O Most Gracious."
When the scorpion glorifies, it says: "Evil is a terrifying thing."

Then he said: "God has not created anything but that it has a glorification by which it praises its Lord." Then he recited this verse: "And there is not a thing but that it glorifies Him with His praise, but you do not understand their glorification."
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 184
44.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 61, p. 27; al-Khara'ij wa al-Jara'ih, Vol. 1, p. 248

44.ar: الباقر (- نَهَی رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (عَنْ أَنْ تُوسَمَ الْبَهَائِمُ فِی وُجُوهِهَا وَ أَنْ تُضْرَبَ وُجُوهُهَا لِأَنَّهَا تُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهَا.
44.fa: پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) از داغ گذاشتن بر صورت چهارپا و زدن به صورت آن، نهی فرمود، زیرا آن حیوان حمد و سپاس پروردگارش را به‌جای می‌آورد.
44.en: The Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) forbade branding animals on their faces and striking their faces, because the animal performs the praise and glorification of its Lord.
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 188

44.ar: الصّادق (- مَا مِنْ طَیْرٍ یُصَادُ فِی بَرٍّ وَ لَا بَحْرٍ وَ لَا یُصَادُ شَیْءٌ مِنَ الْوُحُوشِ إِلَّا بِتَضْیِیعِهِ التَّسْبِیح.
44.fa: صید شدن هر پرنده‌ای چه در خشکی و چه در دریا و شکارشدن هر حیوان وحشی به‌خاطر آن است که در تسبیح و ذکر خداوند اهمال ورزیده‌اند.
44.en: No bird is hunted on land or at sea, and no wild animal is hunted, except because it has neglected the glorification (tasbih) of God.
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 188
44.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 61, p. 24; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

44.ar: الصّادق (- لِلدَّابَّةِ عَلی صَاحِبِهَا سِتَّةُ حُقُوقٍ: لَایُحَمِّلُهَا فَوْقَ طَاقَتِهَا، وَ لَا یَتَّخِذُ ظَهْرَهَا مَجَالِسَ یَتَحَدَّثُ عَلَیْهَا، وَ یَبْدَأُ بِعَلْفِهَا إِذَا نَزَلَ، وَ لَا یَسِمُهَا، وَ لَا یَضْرِبُهَا فِی وَجْهِهَا؛ فَإِنَّهَا تُسَبِّحُ، وَ یَعْرِضُ عَلَیْهَا الْمَاءَ إِذَا مَرَّ بِه.
44.fa: حیوان بر صاحبش شش حق دارد؛ بیشتر از توانش بر او بار نکند، درحالی‌که سوار بر اوست برای صحبت با دیگران توقّف نکند، وقتی پیاده شد، حیوان را علف بدهد، بر صورتش داغ و علامت نگذارد و آن را نزند؛ زیرا آن حیوان نیز خدا را تسبیح می‌گوید و هرگاه بر آب گذر کرد، آن را بر حیوان عرضه کند.
44.en: A beast has six rights over its owner: he should not load it beyond its capacity, he should not use its back as a place to sit and converse with others, he should begin by feeding it when he dismounts, he should not brand it, he should not strike it on its face—for it glorifies [God]—and he should offer it water whenever he passes by it.
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 188

44.ar: السّجّاد (- دَخَلَ أَمِیرُالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فرَآهُ قَدْ سَجَدَ فَلَمَّا انْفَتَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (ضَرَبَ بِیَدِهِ إِلَی کَتِفِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ (: یَا عَلِیُّ (انْهَضْ بِنَا إِلَی مَنْزِلِکَ لَعَلَّنَا نُصِیبُ طَعَاماً فَقَدْ بَلَغَنَا أَخْذُکَ الدِّینَارَ مِنْ أَبِی جَبَلَةَ قَالَ فَمَضَی وأَمِیرُالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (مُسْتَحْیٍ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (رَابِطٌ عَلَی بَطْنِهِ حَجَراً مِنَ الْجُوعِ حَتَّی قَرَعَا عَلَی فَاطِمَةَ (الْبَابَ فَلَمَّا نَظَرَتْ فَاطِمَةُ (إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ قَدْ أَثَّرَ الْجُوعُ فِی وَجْهِهِ وَلَّتْ هَارِبَةً قَالَتْ وَا سَوْأَتَاهْ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَ مِنْ رَسُولِهِ کَأَنَّ أَبَاالْحَسَنِ (مَا عَلِمَ أَنْ لَمْ یَکُنْ عِنْدَنَا شَیْءٌ مُذْ ثَلَاثٍ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ مَخْدَعاً لَهَا فَصَلَّتْ رَکْعَتَیْنِ ثُمَّ نَادَتْ یَا إِلَهَ مُحَمَّدٍ (هَذَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِیُّکَ وَ فَاطِمَةُ (بِنْتُ نَبِیِّکَ وَ عَلِیٌّ (خَتَنُ نَبِیِّکَ وَ ابْنُ عَمِّهِ وَ هَذَانِ الْحَسَنُ وَ الْحُسَیْنُ (سِبْطَا نَبِیِّکَ اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنَّ بَنِی إِسْرَائِیلَ سَأَلُوکَ أَنْ تُنْزِلَ عَلَیْهِمْ مَائِدَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَأَنْزَلْتَهَا عَلَیْهِمْ وَ کَفَرُوا بِهَا اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنَّ آلَ مُحَمَّد (لَا یَکْفُرُونَ بِهَا ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَتْ مُسَلِّمَةً فَإِذَا هِیَ بِصَحْفَةٍ مَمْلُوءَةٍ مِنْ ثَرِیدٍ وَ عُرَاقٍ فَاحْتَمَلَتْهَا وَ وَضَعَتْهَا بَیْنَ یَدَیْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَأَهْوَی بِیَدِهِ إِلَی الصَّحْفَةِ فَسَبَّحَتِ الصَّحْفَةُ وَ الثَّرِیدُ وَ الْعُرَاقُ فَتَلَا النَّبِیُّ (وَ إِنْ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ یَا عَلِیُّ (کُلْ مِنْ جَوَانِبِ الْقَصْعَةِ وَ لَاتَهْدِمُوا ذِرْوَتَهَا فَإِنَّ فِیهَا الْبَرَکَةَ.
44.fa: امیرمؤمنان (علیه السلام) بر رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) وارد شده و ایشان را درحالت سجده مشاهده نمود؛ چون رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) از سجده برخاست با دست مبارکش بر شانه‌ی علی (علیه السلام) زد و فرمود: «ای علی (علیه السلام)! ما را به خانه‌ات ببر شاید [آنجا] غذایی بیابیم که خبردار شده‌ایم دیناری (سکّه‌ی طلا) از ابوجَبله دریافت کرده‌ای»! پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) حرکت نمود درحالی‌که امیرمؤمنان (علیه السلام) از رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) خجالت می‌کشید و رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) از [شدّتِ] گرسنگی، سنگی را محکم بر شکم خویش بسته بود، تا اینکه (پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) و علی (علیه السلام)) درب خانه‌ی فاطمه (سلام الله علیها) را کوبیدند. چون نگاه فاطمه (سلام الله علیها) به رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) که گرسنگی در چهره‌اش نمایان بود، افتاد به‌سرعت درون خانه برگشت و گفت: «وای از ناتوانی [و شرمساری] از خدا و رسولش (صلی الله علیه و آله)، گویا اباالحسن (علیه السلام) نمی‌داند از سه روز پیش تاکنون چیزی در خانه [برای خوردن] نداریم»، آنگاه داخل خلوتگاهی که داشت شد و دو رکعت نماز گزارد و [چنین با خدا] نجوا نمود: «ای خدای محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله)! این محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله)، پیامبر توست و فاطمه (سلام الله علیها) دختر پیامبرت و علی (علیه السلام) داماد پیامبرت و پسر عمویش و این دو حسن و حسین (علیها السلام) نوادگانِ دختریِ پیامبرت هستند، خداوندا! بنی‌اسرائیل از تو درخواست کردند که سفره‌ی غذایی از آسمان بر آن‌ها فرو فرستی و تو برایشان فرو فرستادی و [بااین‌حال] آن‌ها به آن کفر ورزیدند، خداوندا! خاندان محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله) [اگر بر آن‌ها سفره‌ی غذایی فرو فرستی] به آن کفر نخواهند ورزید». هنگامی‌که سلام نماز را داد و روی خود را به راست و چپ چرخاند؛ ناگهان با ظرف بزرگی پُر از نان روغن مالیده و گوشت پخته روبرو شد، آن را برداشته و در مقابل رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) قرار داد؛ رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) دست خود را به طرف ظرف غذا دراز نمود که ظرف غذا به همراه نان و گوشت، تسبیح خدا گفتند، دراین‌هنگام پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) این آیه را تلاوت فرمود: وَ إِنْ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ، سپس فرمود: «ای علی (علیه السلام)! از کناره‌های ظرف بخور و روی غذا را از بین نبرید که برکت در آن است».
44.en: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) entered upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and saw him in prostration. When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) rose from his prostration, he struck his hand upon his shoulder and said, "O Ali, take us to your house, perhaps we may find some food, for it has reached us that you have received a dinar from Abu Jabalah." He set off, while the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) felt shy before the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had a stone tied against his stomach due to hunger. They knocked on the door of Fatimah (peace be upon her). When Fatimah (peace be upon her) looked at the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and saw the effects of hunger on his face, she turned and fled, saying, "Woe to me from Allah and His Messenger! It is as if Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) does not know that we have had nothing in the house for three days." She then entered her private chamber, prayed two rak'ahs, and called out, "O God of Muhammad! This is Muhammad, Your Prophet; and Fatimah, the daughter of Your Prophet; and Ali, the son-in-law of Your Prophet and his cousin; and these are Hasan and Husayn, the grandsons of Your Prophet. O Allah, the Children of Israel asked You to send down a table spread from heaven, and You sent it down to them, yet they disbelieved in it. O Allah, the Family of Muhammad will not disbelieve in it." She then turned to complete her prayer with the taslim, and suddenly she was before a large platter filled with tharid (bread soaked in broth) and meat. She took it and placed it before the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) reached his hand toward the platter, and the platter, the tharid, and the meat glorified Allah (tasbih). The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) then recited: "And there is not a thing but that it glorifies Him with His praise." He then said, "O Ali, eat from the sides of the platter and do not destroy its top, for the blessing is in it."
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 188
44.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 35, p. 251; Furat al-Kufi, p. 524

45.ar: أمیرالمومنین (- رُوِیَ عَنْ مُوسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (عَنْ أَبِیهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنِ الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ (أَنَّ یَهُودِیّاً مِنْ یَهُودِ الشَّامِ وَ أَحْبَارِهِمْ کَانَ قَدْ قَرَأَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَ الْإِنْجِیلَ وَ الزَّبُورَ وَ صُحُفَ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ وَ عَرَفَ دَلَائِلَهُمْ جَاءَ إِلَی مَجْلِسٍ فِیهِ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ فِیهِمْ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (وَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَ أَبُومَعْبَدٍ الْجُهَنِیُّ فَقَالَ یَا أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ (مَا تَرَکْتُمْ لِنَبِیٍّ (دَرَجَةً وَ لَا لِمُرْسَلٍ فَضِیلَةً إِلَّا نَحَلْتُمُوهَا نَبِیَّکُمْ فَهَلْ تُجِیبُونِّی عَمَّا أَسْأَلُکُمْ عَنْهُ فَکَاعَ الْقَوْمُ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ علی بن ابی طالب (نَعَمْ مَا أَعْطَی اللَّهُ عزّوجلّ نَبِیّاً دَرَجَةً وَ لَا مُرْسَلًا فَضِیلَةً إِلَّا وَ قَدْ جَمَعَهَا لِمُحَمَّدٍ (وَ زَادَ مُحَمَّداً (عَلَی الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (أَضْعَافاً مُضَاعَفَةً فَقَالَ لَهُ الْیَهُودِیُّ فَهَلْ أَنْتَ مُجِیبُنِی قَالَ لَهُ نَعَمْ ... قَالَ الْیَهُودِیُّ فَإِنَّ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (حُجِبَ عَنْ نُمْرُودَ بِحُجُبٍ ثَلَاثَةٍ فَقَالَ عَلِیٌّ (لَقَدْ کَانَ کَذَلِکَ وَ مُحَمَّدٌ (حُجِبَ عَمَّنْ أَرَادَ قَتْلَهُ بِحُجُبٍ خَمْسٍ فَثَلَاثَةٌ بِثَلَاثَةٍ وَ اثْنَانِ فَضْلٌ قَالَ اللَّهُ عزّوجلّ وَ هُوَ یَصِفُ أَمْرَ مُحَمَّدٍ (فَقَالَ وَ جَعَلْنا مِنْ بَیْنِ أَیْدِیهِمْ سَدًّا فَهَذَا الْحِجَابُ الْأَوَّلُ وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَهَذَا الْحِجَابُ الثَّانِی فَأَغْشَیْناهُمْ فَهُمْ لا یُبْصِرُونَ فَهَذَا الْحِجَابُ الثَّالِثُ ثُمَّ قَالَ وَ إِذا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنا بَیْنَکَ وَ بَیْنَ الَّذِینَ لایُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجاباً مَسْتُوراً فَهَذَا الْحِجَابُ الرَّابِعُ ثُمَّ قَالَ فَهِیَ إِلَی الْأَذْقانِ فَهُمْ مُقْمَحُونَ فَهَذِهِ حُجُبٌ خَمْسَة.
45.en: It is narrated from Musa ibn Ja’far, from his father, from his forefathers, from al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them), that a Jew from the Jews of al-Sham—one of their scholars who had read the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the scrolls of the prophets, and was familiar with their proofs—came to a gathering where the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) were present, including Ali ibn Abi Talib, Ibn Abbas, and Abu Ma’bad al-Juhani. He said, "O nation of Muhammad! You have not left any rank for a prophet nor any virtue for a messenger without attributing it to your own Prophet. Will you answer me regarding what I ask you?" The people hesitated to respond to him. Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said, "Yes. Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, has not given any prophet a rank nor any messenger a virtue without gathering them all for Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and He has increased Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) over the prophets many times over." The Jew said to him, "Will you answer me?" He replied, "Yes..." The Jew said, "Indeed, Abraham (peace be upon him) was veiled from Nimrod by three veils." Ali (peace be upon him) said, "It was indeed so. And Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was veiled from those who intended to kill him by five veils; three correspond to the three of Abraham, and two are an additional favor. Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, says, describing the affair of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family): 'And We have put a barrier before them'—this is the first veil—'and a barrier behind them'—this is the second veil—'and covered them, so they do not see'—this is the third veil. Then He says: 'And when you recite the Quran, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a hidden veil'—this is the fourth veil. Then He says: 'So they are up to the chins, and they are with heads raised'—this is the fifth veil."
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 190
45.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 10, p. 32; Al-Ihtijaj, Vol. 1, p. 213; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

45.ar: علی بن إبراهیم (- حِجاباً مَسْتُوراً یَعْنِی یَحْجُبُ اللَّهُ عَنْکَ الشَّیَاطِینَ أَکِنَّةً أَیْ غِشَاوَةً أَیْ صَمَماً نُفُوراً قَالَ کَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِذَا صَلَّی تَهَجَّدَ بِالْقُرْآنِ وَ تَسَمَّعَ لَهُ قُرَیْشٌ لِحُسْنِ صَوْتِهِ فَکَانَ إِذَا قَرَأَ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ فَرُّوا عَنْهُ.
45.fa: حِجاباً مَسْتُورا؛ یعنی خداوند شیاطین را از تو دفع نمود. أَکِنَّةً؛ یعنی پوشش که به معنای کَری (ناشنوائی) است. نُفُورًا؛ رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) هرگاه نماز میگزارد با تلاوت قرآن شبزنده‌داری مینمود و به خاطر صدای زیبا و نیکوی آن حضرت قریش به او گوش فرا میدادند و وقتی بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم را قرائت میفرمود از ایشان می‌گریختند».
45.en: "A hidden barrier" (hijaban masturan) means that Allah shields you from the devils. "Coverings" (akinnah) means a veil, which signifies deafness. "In aversion" (nufuran): Whenever the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would pray, he would spend the night reciting the Quran, and the Quraysh would listen to him because of his beautiful voice. However, whenever he recited "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful," they would flee from him.
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 190
45.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 18, p. 51; al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 20; al-Burhan

45.ar: الصّادق (- دَخَلَ أَبُوالْمُنْذِرِ هِشَامُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ الْکَلْبِیُّ عَلَی أَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ (فَقَالَ أَنْتَ الَّذِی تُفَسِّرُ الْقُرْآنَ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ أَخْبِرْنِی عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عزّوجلّ لِنَبِیِّهِ (وَ إِذا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنا بَیْنَکَ وَ بَیْنَ الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجاباً مَسْتُوراً مَا ذَلِکَ الْقُرْآنُ الَّذِی کَانَ إِذَا قَرَأَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (حُجِبَ عَنْهُمْ قُلْتُ لَا أَدْرِی قَالَ فَکَیْفَ قُلْتَ إِنَّکَ تُفَسِّرُ الْقُرْآنَ قُلْتُ یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (إِنْ رَأَیْتَ أَنْ تُنْعِمَ عَلَیَّ وَ تُعَلِّمَنِیهِنَّ قَالَ آیَةٌ فِی الْکَهْفِ وَ آیَةٌ فِی النَّحْلِ وَ آیَةٌ فِی الْجَاثِیَةِ وَ هِیَ أَ فَرَأَیْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلهَهُ هَواهُ وَ أَضَلَّهُ اللهُ عَلی عِلْمٍ وَ خَتَمَ عَلی سَمْعِهِ وَ قَلْبِهِ وَ جَعَلَ عَلی بَصَرِهِ غِشاوَةً فَمَنْ یَهْدِیهِ مِ-نْ بَعْدِ اللهِ أَفَلا تَذَکَّرُونَ وَ فِ-ی النَّ-حْلِ أُولئِ-کَ الَّذِینَ طَبَعَ اللهُ عَلی قُلُوبِهِمْ وَ سَمْعِهِمْ وَ أَبْصارِهِمْ وَ أُولئِکَ هُمُ الْغافِلُونَ وَ فِی الْکَهْفِ وَ مَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُکِّرَ بِآیاتِ رَبِّهِ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْها وَ نَس-ِیَ ما قَدَّمَتْ یَداهُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنا عَلی قُلُوبِهِمْ أَکِنَّةً أَنْ یَفْقَهُوهُ وَ فِی آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً وَ إِنْ تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَی الْهُدی فَلَنْ یَهْتَدُوا إِذاً أَبَداًُ.
45.en: Abu al-Mundhir Hisham ibn al-Sa’ib al-Kalbi came to Abu ‘Abd Allah (al-Sadiq), who said to him, "Are you the one who interprets the Quran?" He replied, "Yes." He (the Imam) said, "Inform me about the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, to His Prophet: 'And when you recite the Quran, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a hidden veil.' What is that Quran which, when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) recited it, he was veiled from them?" He said, "I do not know." He (the Imam) said, "Then how do you claim to interpret the Quran?" He said, "O son of the Messenger of Allah, if you would be so kind as to teach me them." He (the Imam) said, "It is one verse in al-Kahf, one verse in al-Nahl, and one verse in al-Jathiyah. They are: 'Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded?' (Jathiyah/23). And in al-Nahl: 'Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision Allah has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless.' (Nahl/108). And in al-Kahf: 'And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance, they will never be guided, then.' (Kahf/57)."
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 190
45.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 89, p. 283; ‘Uddat al-Da’i, p. 295

45.ar: أمیرالمومنین (- کَانَ عَلی بْنُ ابِی طَالِبْ (بِالْکُوفَةِ فِی الْجَامِعِ إِذْ قَامَ إِلَیْهِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ فَقَالَ یَا أَمِیرَالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (إِنِّی أَسْأَلُکَ عَنْ أَشْیَاءَ فَقَالَ سَلْ ... وَ سَأَلَهُ کَمْ حَجَّ آدَمُ (مِنْ حَجَّةٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ سَبْعِینَ حَجَّةً مَاشِیاً عَلَی قَدَمَیْهِ وَ أَوَّلُ حَجَّةٍ کَانَ مَعَهُ الصُّرَدُ یَدُلُّهُ عَلَی مَوَاضِعِ الْمَاءِ وَ خَرَجَ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ قَدْ نُهِیَ عَنْ أَکْلِ الصُّرَدِ وَ الْخُطَّافِ وَ سَأَلَهُ مَا بَالُهُ لَا یَمْشِی عَلَی الْأَرْضِ قَالَ لِأَنَّهُ نَاحَ عَلَی بَیْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ فَطَافَ حَوْلَهُ أَرْبَعِینَ عَاماً یَبْکِی عَلَیْهِ وَ لَمْ یَزَلْ یَبْکِی مَعَ آدَمَ (فَمِنْ هُنَاکَ سَکَنَ الْبُیُوتَ وَ مَعَهُ تِسْعُ آیَاتٍ مِنْ کِتَابِ اللَّهِ عزّوجلّ مِمَّا کَانَ آدَمُ یَقْرَؤُهَا فِی الْجَنَّةِ وَ هِیَ مَعَهُ إِلَی یَوْمِ الْقِیَامَةِ ثَلَاثُ آیَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الْکَهْفِ وَ ثَلَاثُ آیَاتٍ مِنْ سُبْحَانَ وَ هِیَ وَ إِذا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ وَ ثَلَاثُ آیَاتٍ مِنْ یس وَ جَعَلْنا مِنْ بَیْنِ أَیْدِیهِمْ سَدًّا وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا.
45.fa: روزی امیرالمؤمنین (علیه السلام) درمسجد جامع کوفه بود مردی از اهالی شام از جای حرکت کرده، گفت: «یا امیرالمؤمنین (علیه السلام)! من چند سؤال از تو دارم». فرمود: «بپرس». ... پرسید: «آدم (علیه السلام) چند مرتبه حج به‌جا آورد»؟ فرمود: «هفتاد حج پیاده رفت، اوّلین حجی که به‌جا آورد جغد به همراهش بود و مواضع آب را به او نشان می‌داد و به همراه او از بهشت بیرون آمده بود. آدم (علیه السلام) از خوردن جغد و پرستو منع شد». مرد شامی پرسید: «چرا پرستو روی زمین راه نمی‌رود؟ حضرت فرمود: «زیرا بر بیت المقدس نوحه سرایی نمود و چهل سال بر آن گریست و همیشه به همراه آدم (علیه السلام) می‌گریست. لذا در خانه‌هایی سکنی گزید و نُه آیه از آیات کتاب خداوند عزّ‌وجلّ که آدم (علیه السلام) در بهشت آن‌ها را می‌خواند، به همراه داشت و تا قیامت نیز به همراه خواهد داشت. آن آیات عبارتند از: سه آیه از اوّل سوره «کهف»، سه آیه از سوره «إسراء» که عبارتند از: سُبْحانَ الَّذی أَسْری بِعَبْدِهِ لَیْلاً مِنَ المَسْجِدِ الحَرامِ إِلَی الْمسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَی الَّذی بارَکْنا حَوْلَهُ لِنُرِیَهُ مِنْ آیاتِنا إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمیعُ الْبَصیرُ؛ و آن‌ها این است: وَ إِذا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ و سه آیه از یس وَ جَعَلْنا مِنْ بَیْنِ أَیْدیهِمْ سَدًّا وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا».
45.en: Amir al-Mu'minin (Ali ibn Abi Talib) was in the Grand Mosque of Kufa when a man from the people of Syria stood up and said, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, I wish to ask you about some things." He replied, "Ask." ... He asked him, "How many times did Adam perform the Hajj?" He replied, "Seventy times, walking on his own feet. On his first Hajj, the shrike (bird) was with him, guiding him to the locations of water; it had come out of Paradise with him. Adam was forbidden from eating the shrike and the swallow." The man asked, "Why does the swallow not walk upon the earth?" He replied, "Because it lamented over Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem) and wept over it for forty years, and it continued to weep alongside Adam. Therefore, it took up residence in houses, and it possesses nine verses from the Book of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, which Adam used to recite in Paradise, and they will remain with it until the Day of Resurrection: three verses from the beginning of [Surah] al-Kahf, three verses from [Surah] Subhan (al-Isra), which are [the beginning of the Surah and] 'And when you recite the Quran...', and three verses from [Surah] Ya-Sin: 'And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier...'"
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 192
45.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 10, p. 78; 'Ilal al-Shara'i', Vol. 2, p. 493 (with the section "He asked him how many times Adam performed Hajj... regarding eating the shrike" omitted); 'Uyun Akhbar al-Rida, Vol. 1, p. 243; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 16, p. 120 (with the section "He asked him how many times Adam performed Hajj... regarding eating the shrike" omitted); Nur al-Thaqalayn.

45.ar: الرّسول (- لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ تَبَّتْ یَدا أَبِی لَهَبٍ أَقْبَلَتِ الْعَوْرَاءُ أُمُّ جَمِیلِ بِنْتِ حَرْبٍ وَ لَهَا وَلْوَلَةٌ وَ هِیَ تَقُولُ مُذَمَّماً أَبَیْنَا وَ دِینَهُ قَلَیْنَا وَ أَمْرَهُ عَصَیْنَا وَ النَّبِیُّ (جَالِسٌ فِی الْمَسْجِدِ وَ مَعَهُ أَبُوبَکْرٍ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا أَبُوبَکْرٍ قَالَ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (أَنَا أَخَافُ أَنْ تَرَاکَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِنَّهَا لَا تَرَانِی وَ قَرَأَ وَ إِذا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنا بَیْنَکَ وَ بَیْنَ الَّذِینَ لایُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجاباً مَسْتُوراً فَوَقَفَتْ عَلَی أَبِی بَکْرٍ وَ لَمْ تَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَتْ یَا أَبَابَکْرٍ أُخْبِرْتُ أَنَّ صَاحِبَکَ هَجَانِی فَقَالَ لَا وَ رَبِّ الْبَیْتِ مَا هَجَاکَ فَوَلَّتْ وَ هِیَ تَقُولُ قُرَیْشٌ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّی بِنْتُ سَیِّدِهَا.
45.en: When the verse "May the hands of Abu Lahab perish" (Surah Masad/1) was revealed, the cross-eyed Umm Jamil bint Harb approached, wailing and saying: "We reject the reviled one (Mudhammam), we despise his religion, and we disobey his command." The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was sitting in the mosque with Abu Bakr. When Abu Bakr saw her, he said, "O Messenger of Allah, I fear that she will see you." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) replied, "She will not see me," and he recited: "And when you recite the Quran, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a hidden veil." She stopped before Abu Bakr but did not see the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). She said, "O Abu Bakr, I have been informed that your companion has satirized me." Abu Bakr replied, "No, by the Lord of the House, he has not satirized you." She turned away, saying, "Quraysh knows that I am the daughter of its leader."
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 192
45.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 18, p. 72; Nur al-Thaqalayn; "She said, O Abu Bakr, I have been informed... that I am the daughter of its leader" is omitted.

45.ar: الرّسول (- مِنْ مُعْجِزَاتِهِ أَنَّهُ (کَانَ یُصَلِّی مُقَابِلَ الْحَجَرِ الْأَسْوَدِ وَ یَسْتَقْبِلُ بَیْتَ الْمَقْدِسِ وَ یَسْتَقْبِلُ الْکَعْبَةَ فَلَا یَرَی حَتَّی یَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ وَ کَانَ یَسْتَتِرُ بِقَوْلِهِ وَ إِذا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنا بَیْنَکَ وَ بَیْنَ الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجاباً مَسْتُوراً وَ بِقَوْلِهِ أُولئِکَ الَّذِینَ طَبَعَ اللهُ عَلی قُلُوبِهِمْ وَ بِقَوْلِهِ وَ جَعَلْنا عَلی قُلُوبِهِمْ أَکِنَّةً أَنْ یَفْقَهُوهُ وَ فِی آذانِهِمْ وَقْراً وَ بِقَوْلِهِ أَفَرَأَیْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلهَهُ هَواهُ وَ أَضَلَّهُ اللهُ عَلی عِلْمٍ وَ خَتَمَ عَلی سَمْعِهِ وَ قَلْبِهِ وَ جَعَلَ عَلی بَصَرِهِ غِشاوَةً.
45.en: Among the miracles of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) is that he would pray facing the Black Stone, while facing toward Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem) and the Kaaba, and no one would see him until he had finished his prayer. He would conceal himself with the words of Allah: "And when you recite the Quran, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a hidden veil" (17:45), and with His words: "They are those upon whose hearts Allah has set a seal" (16:108), and with His words: "And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness" (17:46), and with His words: "Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil?" (45:23).
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 192

45.ar: الکاظم (- عُوذَةُ مَوْلَانَا الْکَاظِمِ (لَمَّا أُلْقِیَ فِی بِرْکَةِ السِّبَاع ... احْجُزْ بَیْنِی وَ بَیْنَ أَعْدَائِی فَلَنْ یَصِلُوا إِلَیَّ بِسُوءٍ أَبَداً بَیْنِی وَ بَیْنَهُمْ سِتْرُ اللَّهِ الَّذِی سَتَرَ بِهِ الْأَنْبِیَاءُ عَنِ الْفَرَاعِنَةِ وَ مَنْ کَانَ فِی سِتْرِ اللَّهِ کَانَ مَحْفُوظاً حَسْبِیَ اللَّهُ الَّذِی یَکْفِینِی مَا لَا یَکْفِینِی أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ وَ إِذا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنا بَیْنَکَ وَ بَیْنَ الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجاباً مَسْتُوراً. إِنَّا جَعَلْنا فِی أَعْناقِهِمْ أَغْلالًا فَهِیَ إِلَی الْأَذْقانِ فَهُمْ مُقْمَحُونَ* وَجَعَلْنا مِنْ بَیْنِ أَیْدِیهِمْ سَدًّا وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَیْناهُمْ فَهُمْ لا یُبْصِرُون.
45.fa: حرز مولای ما حضرت کاظم (علیه السلام) هنگامی که ایشان را در گودال درندگان افکندند. ... میان من و دشمنانم مانعی بگذار تا هرگز با هیچ بدی به من نرسند. میان من و آن‌ها پوشش خداوند است که با آن پیامبران را از فرعون‌ها پوشاند و هرکس در پوشش خدا درآید حفظ می‌شود. خداوند برای من کافی است، او که مرا کفایت می‌کند از آن چه هیچ‌کس از خلقش مرا کفایت نمی‌کند؛ وَ إِذا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنا بَیْنَکَ وَ بَیْنَ الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجاباً مَسْتُوراً. إِنَّا جَعَلْنا فِی أَعْناقِهِمْ أَغْلالًا فَهِیَ إِلَی الْأَذْقانِ فَهُمْ مُقْمَحُونَ* وَجَعَلْنا مِنْ بَیْنِ أَیْدِیهِمْ سَدًّا وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَیْناهُمْ فَهُمْ لا یُبْصِرُون.
45.en: The protective prayer (hirz) of our master, al-Kazim (peace be upon him), when he was cast into the pit of wild beasts: "...Place a barrier between me and my enemies, so that they may never reach me with any harm. Between me and them is the veil of Allah, with which He veiled the prophets from the Pharaohs; and whoever is within the veil of Allah is protected. Allah is sufficient for me; He who suffices me against that which none of His creation can suffice me. 'And when you recite the Quran, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a hidden veil. Indeed, We have placed shackles on their necks, and they are up to their chins, so they are with heads raised [in pride]. And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.'"
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 194
